method: Whitespace-normalized literal containment is a citation diagnostic, not a factual accuracy score. Manual defects are examples from this sample, not a corpus error estimate.

rows.title: Fetch an NVOS image over SCP
rows.summary: From the NVOS command prompt, use nv action fetch system image with an SCP URL to retrieve an image onto the switch.

rows.title: Restart and clear the IS-IS process
rows.summary: Restarts the IS-IS process and clears IS-IS data. The command supports optional VRF, tag, wildcard, database, and traffic selectors.

rows.title: Set VRRP group priority
rows.summary: Assigns a priority from 1 through 254 for VRRP master election. The default is 100. Priority 255 guarantees ownership only when the virtual address equals the interface primary IP address.

rows.title: Use no boot config-file
rows.summary: Note Stacking is supported only on Catalyst 2960-S switches.
rows.manual_defect: Описание про stacking Catalyst 2960-S не объясняет no boot config-file.

rows.title: Identify the USB device node
rows.summary: Inspect /proc/partitions and use fdisk -l on a candidate device to determine which device represents the inserted USB drive.

rows.title: Inspect detailed IS-IS SR database output
rows.command_text: tools dump router isis sr-database detail
rows.summary: The detailed IS-IS SR database diagnostic displays segment identifiers, labels, advertised system IDs, prefixes, route levels, metrics, next-hop counts, MTU values, LFA state, tunnel state, and SR error status. The documented example uses `tools dump router isis sr-database detail`.

rows.title: Enable applicable Software Blades
rows.summary: In SmartConsole, enable the applicable Software Blades. In Management High Availability, SmartEvent is supported only on the Active Management Server.

rows.title: Set the maximum number of event monitor backup files
rows.summary: Use event-monitor backup max-size to configure the quantity of event monitor backup files maintained by the switch. The documented range is 1 to 200 files and the default is 10. When the limit is exceeded, the oldest file is deleted.

rows.title: Use no spanning-tree mst pre-standard
rows.summary: form of this command.
rows.manual_defect: Описание обрезано до 'form of this command.' и не объясняет команду.

rows.title: Use authentication authentication-type keychain keychain-name
rows.summary: Use authentication authentication-type keychain keychain-name in the documented command context.

rows.title: Set the default VRF for the current session
rows.summary: Use set default-vrf to set the default VRF used by subsequent show commands in the current session. Setting it to none restores display of routes from the system default VRF.

rows.title: Set the 802.1X reauthorization interval
rows.summary: Set the number of seconds between reauthorization attempts on an interface. The default is 3600 seconds and valid values range from 1 through 4294967295 seconds.

rows.title: Configure DHCP NetBIOS name servers
rows.summary: In DHCP pool configuration mode, netbios-name-server specifies one to eight IPv4 NetBIOS WINS name servers in preference order. The no form removes the list.

rows.title: Generate a certificate signing request
rows.summary: The crypto certificate number request command enters Crypto Certificate Request mode and generates a Base64-encoded X.509 certificate request. A self-signed certificate must first be generated, and request fields must match the values used for that certificate. After receiving the CA certificate, import it with crypto certificate import; end exits without generating, while exit generates the request.

rows.title: Set the Tunnel origin TCP connection timeout
rows.summary: originRequest.connectTimeout controls the timeout for establishing a new TCP connection to the origin. It excludes TLS establishment time, which is controlled by tlsTimeout.

rows.title: Use [no] username <s1> ssh-cert-dn <s2> { dsa | rsa }
rows.summary: Update a user's SSH certificate distinguished name and select the DSA or RSA algorithm.

rows.title: Use show hardware flow aging [ instance <inst> ] [ module <num> ]
rows.command_text: show hardware flow aging [ instance <inst> ] [ module <num> ]
rows.summary: Use show hardware flow aging [ instance <inst> ] [ module <num> ] to inspect the documented operational state without changing configuration.

rows.title: OSPF debug contexts
rows.summary: SR OS provides debug router string ospf contexts for RTM, sham-neighbor, SPF, tunnel-endpoint, and virtual-neighbor diagnostics. RTM, sham-neighbor, SPF, and tunnel endpoint selections support all or an address-specific target; SPF additionally supports intra-area, inter-area, and external types.

rows.title: Filter displayed BGP routes with show ip bgp
rows.summary: The show ip bgp route display supports filters for IPv4 multicast, IPv6 unicast, a network and mask, longer prefixes, cluster lists, communities, community lists, dampened paths, extended community lists, AS-path filter lists, flap statistics, neighbors, next hops, paths, peer groups, regular expressions, and summaries. The neighbors all received-routes option displays accepted and rejected routes received from all IPv4 or IPv6 neighbors.

rows.title: Migrate Cisco IOS XE 17.12.x to release 17.15.1 or later
rows.summary: Cisco encourages customers using IOS XE 17.12.x to migrate to Cisco IOS XE Release 17.15.1 or above.

rows.title: Interpret BGP neighbor capability and message fields
rows.summary: Neighbor field descriptions define local-AS no-prepend behavior, iBGP versus eBGP link labels, BGP version, router ID, FSM state, uptime, read and write times, hold and keepalive timers, capabilities, route refresh, MPLS label capability, graceful restart, address-family properties, queue depths, and sent or received message counts by type.

rows.title: Create a file or anonymous memory mapping
rows.command_text: mmap(addr, length, prot, flags, fd, offset)
rows.summary: mmap() creates a virtual-memory mapping for a file, device, or anonymous memory. A null address lets the kernel choose a page-aligned location; a non-null address is a hint. File offsets must be page-size multiples, and the descriptor may be closed after mapping.

rows.title: 3338 ExtremeXOS® Command Reference Guide for version 32.3
rows.summary: Use [Page 3339] Commands Syntax Description in the documented command context.
rows.manual_defect: Заголовок страницы и таблицы опубликован как команда; окно содержит show switch bluetooth.

rows.title: Reset a card with hard resets for unsupported MDAs
rows.summary: Allows a reset when some MDAs cannot perform soft resets. MDAs supporting soft reset receive a soft reset, while unsupported MDAs receive a hard reset.

rows.title: List or restore contents of an AIX volume-group backup
rows.summary: lsmksysb lists contents of a volume-group backup from tape, file, CD-ROM, or other media and can restore files from a valid backup source. It supports multi-volume backups such as multiple CDs, DVDs, USB disks, or tapes. lsmksysb -r and restorevgfiles perform identical operations.

rows.title: Reload the netdevsim device
rows.summary: Reloads the netdevsim0 device through the devlink reload command after resource configuration.

rows.title: Fully reset FortiSwitch configuration and data
rows.summary: Removes all configurations, saved user and application data, and licenses, and resets the BIOS environment to defaults. Images saved to partitions are not removed.

rows.title: Export configuration policies
rows.command_text: export policy -filename <export file name> -policies <policy IDs or names>
rows.summary: Exports selected configuration policies to an absolute-path file. The command requires the Network Automation Software Ultimate edition license.

rows.title: Interpret detailed BGP EVPN route output
rows.summary: Detailed BGP EVPN output includes route prefixes, status and age, next hop, learned-from peer, local preference, MED, origin, weight, AS path, extended communities, route-target information, tunnel encapsulation, VNI, ESI, and administrative distance where present.

rows.title: Display switch forwarding modes
rows.summary: Displays the switch's current forwarding-plane hardware mode and available forwarding modes. The documented related configuration command is switch forwarding-mode.
